articles.summary: GLENS FALLS, N.Y. and UTICA, N.Y. (June 1, 2026) – Arrow Financial Corporation (NASDAQGS: AROW) (“Arrow” or "AROW"), the parent company of Arrow Bank National Association, and Adirondack Bancorp, Inc. (“Adirondack”), the parent company of Adirondack Bank, today announced they have received the approval of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency ("OCC") to proceed with the previously announced merger of Arrow and Adirondack. articles.title: Arrow Financial Corporation and Adirondack Bancorp, Inc. Receive OCC Approval for Merger
